scenario.name: 802.1X failure caused by a broad firewall UDP deny
scenario.description: A rule meant to stop UDP scanning from Singapore is placed above the RADIUS allow rule on the data centre firewall; DNS and DHCP are permitted by earlier rules, but RADIUS from SIN-SW-01 is denied and 802.1X fails on the Singapore user VLAN.

incident.title: Singapore wired desktops fail 802.1X authentication
incident.description: Singapore desktops report 'authentication failed' and have no network. IP phones work. A switch port change was made at the site this morning.

ground_truth.root_cause: Rule FWR-DC1-0115 (BLOCK-APAC-UDP-SCAN), committed on DC1-FW-01 one minute before onset, denies all UDP from 10.20.0.0/16 to 10.100.100.0/24 above the RADIUS allow rule FWR-DC1-0120; RADIUS requests from SIN-SW-01 to DC1-SRV-AUTH-01 are dropped and 802.1X fails on Singapore user VLAN 10.
